crossRefs.note: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.
